menu.wrights.exchange_to_hint: Materials placed into exchanged cells. Shift+right-click a block in the world sets this list to that block. Same fill modes and priority list as Shape.
menu.wrights.exchange_pivot_hint: Which point on the exchange footprint pins to where you look or to the world anchor. Default is the center.
menu.wrights.exchange_silk_hint: Return the replaced blocks with silk touch instead of destroying them.
menu.wrights.exchange_void_hint: Clears each matching block before placing Replace with. Off skips occupied cells. Turn this on to actually swap solids.
menu.wrights.exchange_form_hint: Presets set Kind and Axis for you. Wall faces the way you look. Rectangle has Width×Height; Square is Size only. Column is always 1×1. Ctrl+scroll changes Size (Column height).
hud.wrights.exchange_explain: Right-click exchanges solids in the form. Shift+right-click sets Replace with. Ctrl+scroll changes Size. Ctrl+Shift+right-click opens Exchange. Ctrl+right-click sets the world anchor.
message.wrights.exchange_started: Wrights will exchange up to %s cells
message.wrights.exchange_to_look: Look at a block to set Replace with
message.wrights.exchange_to_blocked: That block cannot be used as Replace with
menu.wrights.shape_preview_wire: Wire preview (too large to count every block)
menu.wrights.shape_kind_hint: Pick a shape, then set Axis and Rotation. Height grows along the chosen axis.
menu.wrights.shape_section_dimensions_hi: How large the shape is. Size is the main extent; Thickness and Height appear when the chosen kind needs them.
menu.wrights.shape_section_orientation_h: Which way the shape grows, and how it rotates around the look or anchor pin.
menu.wrights.shape_section_build_hint: Where the shape pins in the world, and which point on the shape box is used as the pivot.
menu.wrights.shape_size_hint: Half-width of the shape in the plane perpendicular to Axis, in blocks from the center.
menu.wrights.shape_square_width_hint: How many blocks wide the square is on local X (before Axis tips it).
menu.wrights.shape_square_height_hint: How many blocks tall the square is on local Z (before Axis tips it).
menu.wrights.shape_rectangle_size_hint: Edge length of the rectangle in blocks. Width and height are both this size.
menu.wrights.shape_pyramid_size_hint: Half-width of the pyramid’s base in the plane perpendicular to Axis.
menu.wrights.shape_ring_size_hint: Radius of the ring to the outer edge, in the plane perpendicular to Axis.
menu.wrights.shape_circle_diameter_hint: Full width of the circle in blocks (2 × radius), in the plane perpendicular to Axis.
menu.wrights.shape_circle_radius_hint: Radius of the circle in the plane perpendicular to Axis.
menu.wrights.shape_sphere_radius_hint: Radius of the sphere, in blocks from the center.
menu.wrights.shape_dome_radius_hint: Radius of the dome’s floor in the plane perpendicular to Axis.
menu.wrights.shape_cylinder_radius_hint: Radius of the cylinder tube, perpendicular to Axis.
menu.wrights.shape_width_hint: How many blocks wide the box is on local X (before Axis tips it).
menu.wrights.shape_depth_hint: How many blocks deep the box is on local Z (before Axis tips it).
menu.wrights.shape_cube_size_hint: Edge length of the cube in blocks. Width, depth, and height are all this size.
menu.wrights.shape_box_size_hint: Half-size of the box face perpendicular to Axis (the other two axes). Along-axis 1 makes a flat square.
menu.wrights.shape_height_hint: How far the shape grows along Axis Y (up) from the base.
menu.wrights.shape_along_x_hint: How far the shape grows along Axis X from the base.
menu.wrights.shape_along_z_hint: How far the shape grows along Axis Z from the base.
menu.wrights.shape_box_height_hint: How many blocks tall the box is (local Y before Axis tips it). 1 is a flat plate.
menu.wrights.shape_cylinder_height_hint: How tall the cylinder is along Axis Y from the base.
menu.wrights.shape_cylinder_along_x_hint: How far the cylinder extends along Axis X from the base.
menu.wrights.shape_cylinder_along_z_hint: How far the cylinder extends along Axis Z from the base.
menu.wrights.shape_ring_height_hint: Tube height of the donut along Axis Y. 1 stays a flat ring; higher rounds into a torus.
menu.wrights.shape_ring_along_hint: Tube extent of the donut along the chosen Axis. 1 stays a flat ring; higher rounds into a torus.
menu.wrights.shape_thickness_hint: How wide the ring or donut tube is in the ring’s cross-section. Independent of Size; if thicker than the radius, the hole fills in.
menu.wrights.shape_axis_hint: Which world axis the shape’s height follows. Y is upright; X or Z tips the shape on its side (e.g. a sideways cylinder).
menu.wrights.shape_rotation_hint: Turns the whole footprint 90° around the look or anchor pin (same as Ctrl+scroll). With a corner pivot the box orbits that cell through the four sides; a center pivot spins in place.
menu.wrights.shape_plane_hint: Which flat plane a 2D shape sits on.
menu.wrights.shape_place_hint:
Look: right-click builds where you aim.
On anchor: Ctrl+right-click sets a world point (and switches here from Look), then right-click builds with the pivot there.
Ctrl+Shift+right-click opens that mode’s tweak menu.
menu.wrights.shape_look_lock_hint:
Off: right-click builds where you look right away.
On: right-click locks the snap first, then right-click again to build.
Ctrl+Shift+right-click opens the look-point editor. Ctrl+right-click switches to On anchor and sets the world anchor.
menu.wrights.shape_pivot_hint: Which point on the shape’s box pins to the look cell or world anchor — any face corner, edge middle, face center, or the middle of the whole shape.
screen.wrights.shape_pivot_hint: Pick a face, then click a corner, edge middle, or the face center. Or choose the middle of the entire shape. That point is what sticks to where you look or to the world anchor.
menu.wrights.shape_under_me_hint: Sets the anchor from your current spot so you end up standing in the center of the shape’s top face when it finishes.
menu.wrights.shape_hollow_hint: Only the shell is built. Leave off for a solid fill.
menu.wrights.shape_randomize_hint: Each block is picked at random from block items on your action bar.
menu.wrights.shape_void_hint: Voids the block or fluid in each cell before placing the shape block.
menu.wrights.shape_materials_hint:
Full cube blocks only — no dust, plants, chests, or other NBT blocks. Pick from the list or drag a block from JEI onto the panel. Random uses weights. Priority and Order use left-to-right list order. At least one is required.
Weight / per-block steps: 1 · Ctrl 5 · Shift 10 · Alt 50 · Ctrl+Shift 100
menu.wrights.shape_priority_hint: Blocks are taken from these sources in order. Main hand is only the held slot; Hotbar is the other hotbar slots. Remove a source to skip it. Add it back below.
menu.wrights.shape_none: No shape anchor. Ctrl+right-click a block to set one, or Change below.
menu.wrights.shape_anchor_section_hint:
The center Shape mode builds around when Place is set to Anchor.
Highlight shows it in the world. Clear removes it. Change opens a window to type or nudge the coordinates with a nearby-block preview.
screen.wrights.shape_anchor_hint:
Nudge X, Y, Z or jump to your position / look target. The preview shows blocks around the point.
Nudge steps: 1 · Ctrl 5 · Shift 10 · Alt 50 · Ctrl+Shift 100
menu.wrights.mirror_section_options_hint: NBT copy, shapes in the pattern, replace, mine copies, and whether mirroring is on.
menu.wrights.mirror_section_anchor_hint: Highlight or clear the mirror anchor in this world.
menu.wrights.mirror_mode_hint:
Blocks: right-click places the block in your other hand, and wrights build the copies.
Blueprints: right-click queues the blueprint you have armed, plus its copies.
menu.wrights.mirror_blocks_hint: Right-click places the block in your other hand. Wrights build the reflected copies. Hold the controller in one hand and the block in the other.
menu.wrights.mirror_blueprints_hint: Right-click queues the blueprint you have armed, plus its reflected copies.
menu.wrights.mirror_style_hint:
Axis: pick X, Y, or Z below. One or more. The copies mirror through the anchor on those axes.
Anchored face: the face you Ctrl+right-click sets the axis, and you pick how many copies.
menu.wrights.mirror_pattern_hint: How many copies, from 1 to 32. They are spaced evenly around the middle of the anchor, in the plane of the face you clicked. 1 is only the block you place.
menu.wrights.mirror_axis_hint:
X mirrors east and west through the anchor. Y mirrors up and down. Z mirrors north and south.
Turn on more than one to mirror on each of them. At least one stays on.
menu.wrights.mirror_axis_anchor_hint: Uses the pattern below and the face you clicked. The copy mirrors through the middle of that block, on that face's axis.
menu.wrights.mirror_axis_x_hint: Mirrors through the middle of the anchor block, the same distance east and west.
menu.wrights.mirror_axis_y_hint: Mirrors through the middle of the anchor block, the same distance up and down.
menu.wrights.mirror_axis_z_hint: Mirrors through the middle of the anchor block, the same distance north and south.
menu.wrights.mirror_lead: Wrights build a reflected copy of each blueprint you place.
menu.wrights.mirror_none: No anchor yet. Ctrl+right-click a block face. Ctrl+right-click the air to clear it.
menu.wrights.mirror_other_world: The anchor is in another world. Set it again here, or clear it.
menu.wrights.mirror_copies: %s copies · each one needs its own blocks
menu.wrights.mirror_paused: Paused · %s copies when you turn it back on
menu.wrights.mirror_pair_hint: 2 copies. The one you place, and one through the middle of the anchor, on the axis of the face you clicked.
menu.wrights.mirror_cross_hint: 4 copies through the middle of the anchor, on that face's axis and the axis beside it.
menu.wrights.mirror_eight_hint: 8 copies around the anchor corner, in the plane of the face you clicked.
menu.wrights.mirror_sixteen_hint: 16 copies in a circle around the middle of the anchor, in the plane of the face you clicked.
menu.wrights.mirror_shapes_hint: Stairs, slabs and facing are turned so the copy matches the reflection.
menu.wrights.mirror_replace_hint: When off, a spot that already has a block gets no ghost and is skipped. Air, including cave air, still gets a copy.
menu.wrights.mirror_on_hint: Wrights build the copies. Off keeps the anchor but skips them.
menu.wrights.mirror_mine_hint: Breaking a block sends wrights to mine the mirrored copies as one job. Drops follow the tool you are holding, including silk touch, and go into your inventory or at your feet if it is full. Void removes them with no drops. Same block only mines that block. Any plain block also mines other blocks that do not store data.
menu.wrights.mirror_mine_void_hint: The wrights remove the mirrored blocks and drop nothing, including what a chest was holding.
menu.wrights.mirror_mine_silk_hint: Mirrored blocks drop as the block itself. Off uses your tool's normal drops, without silk touch.
menu.wrights.mirror_clear_hint: Removes the anchor. Ctrl+right-click in the air does the same.
menu.wrights.mirror_highlight_hint: Marks the anchor for 5 seconds and draws a line from you to that block.
menu.wrights.mirror_steps: Ctrl+right-click a face to set the anchor. Right-click places a block or queues a blueprint. Ctrl+Shift+right-click opens this menu.
hud.wrights.shape_look_explain: Right-click builds where you look. Ctrl+Shift+right-click edits the point. Ctrl+right-click sets a world anchor.
hud.wrights.shape_look_snap_ready: Point set. Right-click builds there. Ctrl+Shift+right-click edits it. Ctrl+right-click sets a world anchor.
hud.wrights.shape_look_lock_explain: Right-click locks the snap where you look. Ctrl+Shift+right-click edits it. Ctrl+right-click sets a world anchor.
hud.wrights.shape_look_locked: Snap locked. Right-click builds. Ctrl+Shift+right-click edits it. Ctrl+right-click sets a world anchor.
hud.wrights.shape_anchor_explain: Ctrl+right-click a block to set the shape anchor. Ctrl+Shift+right-click opens the anchor editor.
hud.wrights.shape_anchor_ready: Anchor set. Right-click builds there. Ctrl+right-click air clears it. Ctrl+Shift+right-click edits it.
screen.wrights.shape_look_snap_hint: Move the locked snap on X, Y, or Z. Confirm keeps it, Cancel restores, Clear follows the mouse again.
screen.wrights.shape_look_snap_steps: Nudge steps: 1 · Ctrl 5 · Shift 10 · Alt 50 · Ctrl+Shift 100
hud.wrights.mirror_explain: Ctrl+right-click a face to set the anchor. Ctrl+Shift+right-click opens Mirror options.
hud.wrights.mirror_ready: Anchor set. Ctrl+right-click a face to move it. Ctrl+Shift+right-click opens Mirror options.
hud.wrights.mirror_blocks_explain: Right-click places the block in your other hand. Ctrl+right-click a face sets the anchor.
hud.wrights.mirror_blocks_ready: Anchor set. Right-click places. Ctrl+right-click air clears the anchor.
hud.wrights.mirror_blueprint_explain: Right-click queues the blueprint. Ctrl+right-click a face sets the anchor.
hud.wrights.mirror_blueprint_ready: Anchor set. Right-click queues the blueprint. Ctrl+right-click air clears it.

help.wrights.title: Wrights help
help.wrights.subtitle: Modes, tools, and how the controller works
help.wrights.open_hint: A guide to every controller mode, Build tool, and menu.
help.wrights.start.lead: Hold a Wright Controller. Wrights fly out from your personal wrightport or a placed wrightport, place blocks, then head home.
help.wrights.start.p1: Press B with the controller in hand to open blueprints, jobs, manage, info, and options. You can also right-click the controller in some modes.
help.wrights.start.p2: Wear a personal wrightport in the Curios slot so your wrights travel with you. Place a wrightport in the world when you want a fixed dock and reach.
help.wrights.start.p3: Hold Ctrl+Shift and scroll to change the main mode. Inside New or Build, hold Shift and scroll to pick a capture style or Build tool. The HUD strips show what is selected.
help.wrights.start.tip: Yellow outlines mark a selection or place box. Blue marks the anchor or pivot.
help.wrights.modes.lead: The controller’s main modes sit on Ctrl+Shift+scroll. Each mode has its own HUD line and right-click action.
help.wrights.modes.p1: Hold Ctrl and Shift together, then scroll. The mode strip updates under the crosshair. Options for that mode live in the B menu when it applies.
help.wrights.modes.p_new: New — mark a box in the world and save it as a blueprint. Shift+scroll picks Two corners, Box, or Move.
help.wrights.modes.p_build: Build — place a blueprint, or use Mirror, Shape, Exchange, or Bind inventory. Shift+scroll picks the Build tool.
help.wrights.modes.p_jobs: Jobs — pause, resume, remove, or highlight running and finished builds.
help.wrights.modes.p_manage: Manage — add wrights, move them between jobs, and upgrade tiers on a personal or placed wrightport.
help.wrights.modes.p_info: Info — look at ghosts, holograms, wrights, anchors, or wrightports to read them. Right-click opens supply and digital stock.
help.wrights.modes.p_link: Link — bind a digital network so jobs can pull from AE2 or Refined Storage.
help.wrights.modes.tip: Alt+right-click undoes the last finished build when one is still available.
help.wrights.new.lead: New template captures a region of the world into a blueprint, including block settings and NBT when you ask for them.
help.wrights.new.p1: Switch to New, then Shift+scroll between Two corners, Box, and Move. A yellow selection box shows what will be saved. Corner markers sit on the edges when that option is on.
help.wrights.new.p_corners: Two corners — right-click the first corner, then Shift+right-click the second. The box fills between them.
help.wrights.new.p_box: Box — right-click to aim a box from that corner, then drag or confirm to set the far side. Esc or sneak lets go while aiming.
help.wrights.new.p_move: Move — needs a box first. Look at the selection, right-click to grab it, then right-click again to put it down.
help.wrights.new.p2: The adjust screen lets you rename, nudge, rotate, and flip before saving. You can save chests and machines empty, keep their settings, or in Creative save a full copy. Hold Ctrl and scroll while looking at a face to resize that side.
help.wrights.new.tip: Copy fluids and NBT options live on the capture / paste pages. Survival never saves a full inventory dump unless the server allows Creative full NBT.
help.wrights.build.lead: Use template places a saved blueprint with a hologram. Other Build tools sit on Shift+scroll beside it.
help.wrights.build.p1: Open the B menu, pick a blueprint, and choose Build — or stay in Build mode with Use template selected. A hologram follows where you look. Yellow is the place outline; blue is the pin / pivot.
help.wrights.build.p_tools: Shift+scroll cycles Use template, Mirror, Shape, Exchange, and Bind inventory.
help.wrights.build.p_place: Right-click places the hologram and starts a job when materials and wrights allow. Ctrl+right-click pins the build anchor. Ctrl+scroll rotates the template around its pivot.
help.wrights.build.p_menu: Ctrl+Shift+right-click opens the place menu (offsets, supply, materials). If “Right-click opens menu” is on in Options, a plain right-click opens that menu instead of starting the job.
help.wrights.build.p2: Before a job starts, Materials needed lists each item from Player, Inventory (bound chest), and Digital. Unbound sources show -. Missing is what you still lack. Total is the bound sources added up. Creative places for free.
help.wrights.build.tip: If no wright is free and queue jobs is on, the build waits on the Jobs list until a wright that can reach it is free.
help.wrights.mirror.lead: Mirror repeats a block or a whole blueprint around an anchor face. Mining can break the copies as one job.
help.wrights.mirror.p1: In Build, Shift+scroll to Mirror. Ctrl+right-click a block face to set the anchor. Ctrl+right-click air clears it. Ctrl+Shift+right-click opens Mirror options.
help.wrights.mirror.p_blocks: Blocks — hold a placeable block in your other hand. Right-click places that block and its mirrored copies.
help.wrights.mirror.p_plans: Blueprints — with a blueprint armed, right-click queues mirrored copies of the plan around the anchor.
help.wrights.mirror.p_copies: Copies — choose 1 to 32 around the anchored face, or mirror through the middle of the anchor on X, Y, and Z.
help.wrights.mirror.p_mine: Mining — break a block and wrights mine the mirrored copies as one job. Drops follow the tool you hold. Void removes them with no drops.
help.wrights.mirror.tip: Every copy from one click is one job, so Undo clears them together.
help.wrights.shape.lead: Shape grows spheres, boxes, cylinders, and more from a material palette — no blueprint required.
help.wrights.shape.p1: In Build, Shift+scroll to Shape. The Shape page sets kind, size, materials, hollow or solid, aim, and pivot. Ctrl+Shift+right-click opens the tweak menu for the current aim mode.
help.wrights.shape.p_kinds: Kinds — Circle, Square, Rectangle, Box, Cube, Sphere, Cylinder, Dome, Pyramid, Ring (tall rings become a torus). Axis and Rotation tip the shape; Ctrl+scroll turns it in the world like a blueprint.
help.wrights.shape.p_mats: Materials — weighted palette with Random, Priority, and Order fills. Full cube blocks only. Drag plain blocks from JEI onto Pick blocks when JEI is loaded.
help.wrights.shape.p_aim: Aim — Look places where you look (optional snap lock). On anchor uses a world pin set with Ctrl+right-click. Pick which corner or center of the shape box pins to that cell.
help.wrights.shape.p_void: Void blocks clears existing blocks and fluids in each cell before placing. Large shapes stream while they build instead of freezing the server.
help.wrights.shape.tip: Shape air offset in Options pushes a look-at-air snap a few blocks ahead so the preview stays clear of your flight path.
help.wrights.exchange.lead: Exchange swaps solid blocks inside a shape volume for your Replace with materials.
help.wrights.exchange.p1: In Build, Shift+scroll to Exchange. Pick a Form (Floor, Wall, Column, Circle, Rectangle, Square) — orientation is set for you. Rectangle has Width×Height; Square is Size only; Column is always 1×1. Set Replace with on the Exchange page (or Shift+right-click a block). Turn on Void blocks to clear solids before placing.
help.wrights.exchange.p2: Right-click runs the exchange. Shift+right-click aiming at a block sets Replace with. Ctrl+scroll changes Size (Column height). Ctrl+right-click sets the world anchor. Ctrl+Shift+right-click opens Exchange options.
help.wrights.exchange.tip: Wall faces the direction you are looking when you pick it. Exchange still spends items from Player, a bound chest, or a linked network like any other job.
help.wrights.bind.lead: Bind inventory points builds at a chest, barrel, or shulker so jobs can pull from it.
help.wrights.bind.p1: In Build, Shift+scroll to Bind inventory. Right-click a container to bind it. Right-click air clears the bind. Ctrl+Shift+right-click opens the bind menu.
help.wrights.bind.p2: A placed wrightport can bind its own supply chest inside its reach. Personal builds use the controller bind from Bind inventory or the Info page.
help.wrights.bind.tip: Supply order in Options (and on the place menu) chooses whether your inventory or the chest is tried first.
help.wrights.jobs.lead: Jobs tracks every paste, shape, mirror, exchange, and undo that wrights are working on.
help.wrights.jobs.p1: Switch to Jobs on the controller, or open the B menu Jobs page. Working lists live jobs. Finished lists completed, stopped, and undone work.
help.wrights.jobs.p2: Pause, resume, remove, or highlight a job. Highlight draws a box and a guide line. In Creative, Go teleports you to a highlighted wright. Queued jobs wait until a free wright can reach them.
help.wrights.jobs.tip: A stalled job is usually short on items or waiting on a chunk. Check Materials needed and your supply binds.
help.wrights.manage.lead: Manage keeps your crew on a personal wrightport or a placed wrightport.
help.wrights.manage.p1: Personal wrightport — worn in Curios; its wrights travel with you. Placed wrightport — fixed in the world with a reach box.
help.wrights.manage.p_personal: The bulb (and lamps on a placed wrightport) show status: red empty, yellow all out on jobs, green at least one free.
help.wrights.manage.p_ports: Add wrights, move them between jobs, and watch who is out. Network stock can supply wright items when a digital link is bound.
help.wrights.manage.p_upgrades: Upgrades craft from the tier below and hand that tier back. You can jump tiers when you can afford the target upgrade.
help.wrights.manage.tip: Deploy count and Max in Options set how many wrights a new job tries to take, still capped by free wrights and the server limit.
help.wrights.info.lead: Info is for reading the world and checking supply without changing mode tools.
help.wrights.info.p1: Look at a ghost, hologram, wright, mirror or shape anchor, or wrightport. The HUD names what it is and which job it belongs to.
help.wrights.info.p2: Right-click in Info opens network and chest cards: online or offline, bound chest, and Wrights items the network holds or can craft.
help.wrights.info.tip: Bind inventory from Info when you want a chest without leaving the menu stack.
help.wrights.link.lead: Link binds a digital storage network so jobs can pull blocks and request crafts.
help.wrights.link.p1: Switch to Link on the controller. Jobs then count Digital stock on Materials needed and can spend from the network while building.
help.wrights.link.p_ae2: Applied Energistics — put the Wright Controller in a wireless access point that is on the network.
help.wrights.link.p_rs: Refined Storage — right-click an RS Controller while in Link mode.
help.wrights.link.tip: If the network goes offline, Digital shows as unbound or empty until it comes back.
help.wrights.library.lead: Blueprints live in folders you can favorite, share, and carry between worlds on the same game version.
help.wrights.library.p1: Press B to open the blueprint list. Tabs cover All, Last used, Most used, and Favorites. Folders keep large libraries tidy.
help.wrights.library.p_world: World — blueprints saved for this world only.
help.wrights.library.p_global: Global — shared on this computer across worlds and modpacks that use the same Minecraft version.
help.wrights.library.p_transfer: Import / Export copies a blueprint or folder to the system clipboard, pastes one back, or writes it onto a blueprint sheet or folder item.
help.wrights.library.tip: Sheets and folder items stay in your inventory, so you can trade plans or move them by hand.
help.wrights.supply.lead: Every survival job spends real items. Creative places without taking stock.
help.wrights.supply.p1: Player inventory, a bound chest, and a linked digital network can all feed the same job. Options and the place menu set the order.
help.wrights.supply.p_player: Player — what you are carrying, including the offhand.
help.wrights.supply.p_chest: Inventory — the bound chest or container. Shows - when nothing is bound.
help.wrights.supply.p_digital: Digital — the linked AE2 or RS network. Shows - when nothing is linked.
help.wrights.supply.p_materials: Missing is Need minus the bound totals. Total adds only the sources that are bound.
help.wrights.supply.tip: Build anyway starts with what you have and stalls or skips when something runs out, depending on the job.
help.wrights.keys.lead: The same modifiers show up everywhere: mode strips, sliders, and nudge fields.
help.wrights.keys.p1: B opens the Wrights menu. Ctrl+Shift+scroll changes main mode. Shift+scroll changes New capture style or Build tool. Ctrl+scroll rotates a blueprint or shape, or resizes a capture face you are looking at.
help.wrights.keys.p2: Right-click is the main action. Ctrl+right-click sets or pins anchors. Shift+right-click is used for second corners, From blocks, and a few tool shortcuts. Ctrl+Shift+right-click opens the tool’s menu. Alt+right-click undoes the last finished build.
help.wrights.keys.p3: On +/- controls and typed fields, modifiers change the step size the same way across Wrights.
help.wrights.keys.tip: You can drag the HUD message strip and the mode strips in Options if they sit on top of another mod’s UI.
